name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 37 - Am 41
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 37a. Considers it essential to invest in public housing stocks that can influence general market conditions and calls on the Commission to propose a European plan for the construction of public and social housing aimed at reducing inequalities by introducing a requirement of 30 % social and very social housing in new developments, and 40 % in high-demand areas;
